rules_decisions.LYY_A02_delayed_dot: Explicit integration ruling 2026-10-14: 0.30ATK at starts of T+1 and T+2; bosses capped at1%maxHP per tick. Reapplication refreshes the next two ticks without stacking or an immediate tick; highest same-name potency retained. Other two-round statuses remain T..T+1. Resolves combat07:391 versus generic07:157/171 timing ambiguity without rewriting authoritative design.
rules_decisions.p01: First normal action only, preparation layer remains prior; first action actual MP cost ceil(cost/2), no extra action.
